blocks.text: This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your information when you use the anonymous messaging feature on this profile page.
We collect the following information for the operation of the service:
The information collected is used solely for the following purposes:

items: Receiving and reading anonymous messages sent to the profile owner.
Detecting, preventing, and blocking spam, hate speech, or harassment.

blocks.text: This service uses third-party infrastructure for backend processing:
We do not sell or share your personal information with third parties beyond what is necessary for the operation and security of the service.
Personal data is retained only for as long as necessary to provide and protect the service.
You may contact the profile owner to request access to or deletion of your personal data, where applicable.
This service is intended for users who are at least 13 years old. If you are under 13, please do not submit messages through this website.
If you have any questions or would like to request the deletion of a specific message or data, you may contact the profile owner via email at: wahyunapub@gmail.com.
